Proposition
[Linear stability of $K3$ surfaces (Proposition 35.7)] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0305 ↗ def:chow-iv-k3-surface 1. ch35:35.7\group Linear Stability

Every Kähler--Einstein $K3$ surface is linearly stable for Ricci--DeTurck flow. The kernel of $\Delta _L$ is $\varepsilon (g)\oplus G$, where $\varepsilon (g)$ is the product of the $3$-dimensional space of parallel self-dual $2$-forms and the $19$-dimensional space of harmonic anti-self-dual $2$-forms.
